name: Tania Green
source:
"She is a fiery redhead with a good heart that she also wears on her sleeve, causing her to speak before thinking at times. She's been unlucky with her boyfriends and is currently in love with a man she can never be with. She's willing to meet new people, but it will take a special person to capture her heart.
She used to work at Wenchester Security Company but decided to leave and pursue her studies.
She's playful, sexy and determined, with a short temper that can be easily defused by offering a listening ear whenever she needs to vent. She will make for an amazing and trustworthy wife with a thing for kinky sex."

[In-game description]
